# EndFunction <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Functions](Language-Features-Functions)

</div>


```blitzbasic
End Function
EndFunction
```

## Description

Ends a [Function](Function) declaration. `End Function` and `EndFunction` mean the same thing.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Function Hi()
	Print "hi"
End Function
Hi()
```

```text
hi
```
